name: D'Addario EXL110 Electric Strings
description: Regular Light gauge nickel wound electric guitar strings (10-46).
detailedDescription: D'Addario EXL110s are the world's most popular electric guitar strings. Made with nickel-plated steel wound on a high carbon steel core, they deliver bright, balanced tone with excellent intonation. The Regular Light gauge (10-46) provides comfortable playability with good sustain and bendability.

name: Fender Medium Celluloid Picks
description: Classic celluloid guitar picks in medium thickness with traditional teardrop shape.
detailedDescription: Fender's classic celluloid picks provide the warm, round musical tone characteristic of celluloid. The medium thickness (.73mm) offers excellent balance between flexibility and control, making them perfect for both rhythm and lead playing. Available in classic Fender colors with traditional logos.

name: Boss TU-3 Chromatic Tuner
description: Ultra-compact chromatic tuner pedal with high-precision accuracy.
detailedDescription: The Boss TU-3 is the world's top-selling chromatic tuner pedal. It features a large, easy-to-read display with multiple viewing angles, 21-segment LED meter for smooth and accurate visual tuning, and true bypass switching. The rugged BOSS construction ensures reliable performance on stage and in the studio.

name: Ernie Ball Polypro Guitar Strap
description: Comfortable polypropylene guitar strap with leather ends and adjustable length.
detailedDescription: The Ernie Ball Polypro strap offers superior comfort and durability. Made from polypropylene webbing with premium leather ends, it provides excellent weight distribution and security. The adjustable length accommodates players of all sizes, while the classic black design complements any instrument.

name: Dunlop Jazz III Carbon Fiber Picks
description: Precision picks with carbon fiber surface for superior grip and tone.
detailedDescription: The Dunlop Jazz III Carbon Fiber combines the precision and control of the classic Jazz III shape with a carbon fiber surface that provides incredible grip and attack. The unique surface texture prevents the pick from slipping, while the carbon fiber material produces a bright, aggressive tone perfect for fast, intricate playing.

name: Fender Deluxe Gig Bag
description: Premium padded gig bag with multiple pockets and reinforced construction.
detailedDescription: The Fender Deluxe Gig Bag provides excellent protection for your electric guitar. Features 20mm thick padding, reinforced stitching, water-resistant 600 denier polyester exterior, and plush interior lining. Multiple accessory pockets keep picks, cables, and other essentials organized and accessible.

name: Planet Waves 10ft Instrument Cable
description: Professional quality 1/4" instrument cable with oxygen-free copper conductors.
detailedDescription: Planet Waves cables use audiophile quality oxygen-free copper conductors for low capacitance and pure signal transfer. The proprietary In=Out technology ensures the signal going into your amp is identical to the signal leaving your instrument. Lifetime warranty backs the superior construction.

name: Hercules GS414B Guitar Stand
description: Auto-grip single guitar stand with secure locking mechanism.
detailedDescription: The Hercules GS414B features the patented Auto Grip System that automatically secures your guitar when placed in the stand and releases when lifted. The specially formulated foam completely covers all contact points to protect your instrument's finish. Compact folding design for easy transport and storage.

name: Shure SM57 Dynamic Microphone
description: Industry standard dynamic microphone for guitar amplifiers and live sound.
detailedDescription: The legendary Shure SM57 has been the go-to choice for recording guitar amplifiers for over 50 years. Its tailored frequency response and exceptional durability make it perfect for both studio and live applications. The cardioid pickup pattern isolates the main sound source while minimizing background noise.

name: TC Electronic Flashback 2 Delay
description: Versatile delay pedal with multiple algorithms and TonePrint technology.
detailedDescription: The Flashback 2 Delay offers 11 different delay types from vintage tape echo to modern digital delays. TonePrint technology allows you to load custom delay sounds created by your favorite artists. Features include tap tempo, subdivisions, true bypass, and up to 7 seconds of delay time.
